title: test-budget: two dogfood headers (service-account-lifecycle, service-account-register-key) name no class, and none of the three ruled classes fits a one-boot-per-file dogfood test
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsS4GoHCgYwA2uv3n3C

Filing gate: class c, an out-of-scope finding of the #34711 dev round (PR #34835), measured by the seat. ⛔ Not a claim. Grading and `domain:*` are triage's.

Suggested-grade: p2 · the same outcome as #34711 (the timings refresh refuses its regression diff)

## 维护者速读

- 现象：两个 dogfood 测试文件的耗时预算头写着 20 秒，但没写「类别」，耗时刷新脚本读到会拒绝。三个已裁类别都不贴切：这两个文件都是整份只启动一次 showcase。
- 为什么要修：刷新脚本只要读到其中一个，整份回归读数就作废；#34711 修完其余 5 个之后，只剩这一对。
- 需要你做的：可能需要裁一次(加第四个类别，还是这两个文件根本不该有预算头),由分诊判路由。

## Measured

`readTestBudget` from `scripts/measure-test-shard-timings.mjs`, run by the seat over every file carrying a `test-budget` header:
- `origin/main` c513d62a: 169 files, 7 refused.
- PR #34835 head 5d31cacf67 (Fixes #34711): 169 files, 2 refused. The two are:
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/service-account-lifecycle.dogfood.test.ts:2`
  - `packages/qa/dogfood/test/service-account-register-key.dogfood.test.ts:2`

Both read `// test-budget: 20 — one showcase boot for the whole file, its auth and data doors driven in process; no timer is waited out`, which has no `CLASS:` segment. `TEST_BUDGET_CLASSES` holds three values (rulings 6181973363 on #23534, 6212133431 on #23821). None says "one boot for the whole file".

## Options seen (not a recommendation)

- A: drop both headers, if a CI reading puts each file at or under the 10 s line. A header is only for a file above the line.
- B: a fourth class by maintainer ruling, the way #23821 added "compiles the package type graph once".
- C: the files are slimmed under 10 s.

## Re-check

`git grep -n "test-budget" origin/main -- packages/qa/dogfood/test/service-account-lifecycle.dogfood.test.ts packages/qa/dogfood/test/service-account-register-key.dogfood.test.ts`. Control: `git grep -c "test-budget: 60" origin/main -- packages/cli/test/serve-multi-node-gate-declaration.integration.test.ts` hits once PR #34835 lands.

Dedupe: `readTestBudget` (9 hits, none on these files); `"test-budget" dogfood service-account` (16 hits, no open card on these files).
